$comment: U8 — notepad-scoped hooks. Arms ONLY in notepad sessions; Claude Code MERGES this with the user-level agent-notepad read-hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact/Stop). TWO PreToolUse(Bash) gates run on every Bash call, in order. commit-gate.sh intercepts `git [ -C <repo> ] commit` and applies the df-context-store staleness check (DESIGN §7.6). push-gate.sh intercepts `git [ -C <repo> ] push` and applies that repo's own `.claude/docs-map.json` (DESIGN §7.7, scope-init §6a); with no such file it abstains, never a default rule set. BOTH govern AGENT actions only — a human's `git commit` or `git push` in a terminal never reaches a PreToolUse hook, so arm the code repo's own git hooks for those. Runtime path convention per DESIGN §15: the installer (U10) copies hooks to the STABLE path ~/.claude/hooks/agent-notepad/ (NOT the branch-fragile repo path). Bypass one action with `--no-verify`; disable for a session with AGENT_NOTEPAD_COMMIT_GATE=off / AGENT_NOTEPAD_PUSH_GATE=off.
